items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Overnight Jimmy Noon was at the nest, right in the next block, the plantation on the corner, diagonally from the sunset. Then the sunset was right across the street. And he had the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kelly Stables. And Joe Oliver, he went in with Dave Payton at the plantation. So I visited first one place or another, and Louis Armstrong, by that time Louis left the band and went to New York to join Fletcher Henderson I think. And then Louis goes and joins Fletcher Henderson. And then Ori comes up to join Joe Oliver and he had Bob Schaffner and Tick Gray on trumpets. And he had the same Charlie Jackson on bass, bass horn, and he had Albert Nichols and Bonnie Bigard on the- and Darnell Howard. Well…

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: See, we recorded with Jimmy, you know, you ever had the records with Jimmy and the Blues, the Blues jumped the rabbit and things like that.

ctx.x: I understand they tried to put him in the rest of the spare for a while. Yeah.

No, he could play, he really could play. But he didn't read so well. Now a guy, Kelly, a guy Kelly could read and play good too. See, we recorded with Jimmy, you know, you ever had the records with Jimmy and the Blues, the Blues jumped the rabbit and things like that. It was different altogether. He played with South Stan. The guy was always in Baton Rouge.
